name: Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology (IITM)
evidence: The official Contact Us page identifies Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology in Pune and its header states that it is an "Autonomous Institute of the Ministry of Earth Sciences, Govt. of India," supporting classification as a central institute.
notes: Initial TLS verification failed with the managed proxy's self-signed certificate in the chain; used curl --insecure for public GET requests to the official hostname as permitted.
